ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited has submitted the Exchange, the financial results for the Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Change in Management — Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management-Cessation and Appointment of Independent Directors
Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts — Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
Outcome of Board Meeting — Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Acquisition — Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 26% stake in Arts EV Private Limited consequent upon execution of Share Purchase Agreement and Shareholders  Agreement
